title: Tooling: search open-PR overlap by changed file path in find_overlap (no new kappa)
body:
## Result (tooling; no new kappa)

`scripts/find_overlap.py` can now answer **which open PRs touch a given file path** — the changed-file index requested in [the workflow feedback thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18909265) ("the overlap helper can't search by file path ... cache each open PR's changed-file list and make it searchable by path").

```sh
python3 scripts/find_overlap.py --path docs/research/current-status.md
python3 scripts/find_overlap.py --path scripts/find_overlap.py --path tests/test_research_onboarding.py
```

Answered live at the measured snapshot: `docs/research/current-status.md` is touched by exactly one open PR (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1232); `research/lean-external-review` is touched by https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1365 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1494, the stacked level-model phases of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/442.

## Scope

Track `verifier-engineering`, card `replay-runtime`, scope key `b1dd41940c60d240b47a`, chooser seed `a0107446c288cf7a8989cfea985c3344` (OS-random draw). Base `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`; contribution head `7df8e542` on branch `research/agent-20-overlap-path-index-a0107446`; tooling commit `04aecc3d`, package commits `c05e8f30` and `7df8e542`. Scope status **refined**, within the card's allowed variation "design one source-bound cache boundary": the measured check is the overlap helper's own remote refresh, the coordination check the feedback thread names as expensive and unable to see code paths. Task card: `research/overlap-path-index/TASK.json`. This is verifier engineering: no mathematical claim, kappa, supplier, certificate, replay coverage or selected-frontier change.

## Delta

Two commits, five files plus one package:

- `scripts/find_overlap.py`: new `fetch_pr_files` (paginated GraphQL changed-file inventory, third snapshot source `pr_files`, fetched **only** for `--path` queries so body searches are byte-identical in behavior and cost), new `path_report`, and a `--path PATTERN` flag (repeatable; `fnmatch` pattern or literal substring). With both axes given, `matches` is the term-and-path intersection while `path_matches` stays the superset of all path hits (no silent false negative). PRs whose changed-file list is unavailable (e.g. https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/376 at the measured snapshot) are recorded empty and flagged `truncated: true`; PRs beyond GitHub's 100-file listing are flagged `truncated: true`. A failed or partial refresh keeps the previous snapshot and warns; it never reports "no overlap" from missing data without a warning. Diff contents remain unsearched; the report carries a `path_limits` statement.
- `tests/test_research_onboarding.py`: six new fixture tests (exact/substring/glob matching with a rejection control, pagination with truncation flags, null file-list and null node handling, transient-failure retries, fetch-only-on-demand with cache reuse and offline warnings, refresh-failure keeping old records).
- `research/overlap-path-index/`: registered package (TASK.json with the card and scope-change reason, SOURCES.json exact pins, VERIFY.json, verify.py).

## Evidence

Measured on Windows 11, CPython 3.13.15, this host:

| Check | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Body-only overlap query (cached, offline) | 0.48 s | 0.48 s (`pr_files` never fetched) |
| Full changed-file index build | impossible (no path data) | 87.7 s: 745 open PRs, 20,117 changed-path entries |
| Cached offline `--path` query | manual per-PR inspection | 0.48 s |

Page-size evidence: 25-PR pages (up to 2500 nodes) exceed GitHub's ~10 s gateway limit and returned HTTP 502 (failing calls died at 10.5–10.7 s); 10-PR pages completed in 0.8–4.4 s and are what the tool uses, with up to four attempts per page.

Verification (reproducible commands and output):

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/overlap-path-index --check-only
# PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/overlap-path-index
# PASS_OVERLAP_PATH_INDEX  (2 pinned inputs, 11 unit tests, 7 controls)
# PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/overlap-path-index outcome=completed
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
# Ran 26 tests, FAILED (errors=6)
```

The 6 errors are the pre-existing `PackageTests` Windows CRLF-vs-`autocrlf` fixture failures documented by https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1298; they are untouched here. Baseline recorded from the base commit's tree on this host: `Ran 20 tests ... FAILED (errors=6)` — the same 6 errors, so this change adds 6 passing tests and no new failure. The package verifier's seven controls (positive, substring, glob, rejection, term-and-path, mutation, missing-index) run hermetically against a fixture snapshot cache placed outside the repository.

Not checked: no hosted-CI run, no Linux/macOS execution, no independent human review, no full selected cold replay, no closed-PR path coverage.

## Overlap

Fresh `find_overlap.py` searches before submission for `overlap-path-index`, `path index`, `changed-file index`, `find_overlap.py`, `searchable by path`, `changed-file list`, `file inventory cache` matched only the request itself, this package and this PR's own claim (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18914239). The new `--path` mode reports the nearest textual neighbors: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1298 (Windows/UTF-8 portability of the same script and tests; complementary, different concern, possible textual conflict) and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1299 (PYTHONOPTIMIZE assertions in the same test file). Replay optimizations in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1461, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1584 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1101 concern different objects. No matching active claim was found; claims are advisory and no-match is not a novelty certificate.

## Open next questions

In `research/overlap-path-index/README.md` and structured in its TASK.json: closed-PR path coverage via the ledger's `COVERAGE.json.gz` inventories (blocked on an explicit coverage label); cheaper index refresh via per-page caching keyed by PR head sha (blocked on GraphQL having no ETags for this connection); exact base/head stacking chains beyond shared-path approximation (blocked on stacked PRs naming parents only in prose).

## Credit

- Douglas Colkitt: the overlap helper, its snapshot design and coverage contract (Apache-2.0, retained; changed only as described here).
- Mister-Meeseeks: the changed-file request, [discussion 1200](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18909265) item 2.
- rtyu193-rgb (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1298): onboarding UTF-8/Windows fixes to the same script; complementary and not included here.

Contribution by **Aaron Wang / navinor**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance in design, implementation, tests, measurements and writing). Apache-2.0. No merge or selected-frontier change requested.

## Workflow feedback (brief)

Task `replay-runtime` refined after the draw; the chooser's card did not reflect that both suggested objects had live coverage nearby. Biggest friction: GitHub's ~10 s GraphQL gateway limit 502ing large changed-file pages (cost two debugging rounds; recorded above as evidence). Suggested improvement: the card's `first_step` could link the feedback thread's open tooling requests the way it links the baseline command — this task came from there, not from the catalogue.
